engagement: pollinations authorized red-team audit (repo-only + local PoC verification)
authorized_by: repo owner / task brief (explicit permission to read source, write PoCs, test PoCs locally; NOT to flood or degrade production)
rules: No volumetric/load testing against any production host (gen/media/enter.pollinations.ai, pollinations.app).
No DoS, no stress, no repeated automated requests to production.
At most a single benign read-only verification request to a production host, and only if code evidence is ambiguous.
No real credentials, no user data, no exploitation of third-party systems.
All PoCs must be proven in the local environment (workers-pool vitest / local wrangler dev) before being reported.
No PRs to the upstream repository; findings are written to issue1.md / issue2.md in this working repo only.
out_of_scope: accessing real user accounts or third-party infrastructure
cloud metadata probing from production workers
exfiltrating or modifying real platform data
